src.label: Oman Customs (Directorate General of Customs) — veterinary permit to import dogs and cats

head: A prior veterinary permit is required, with a rabies antibody blood test and a banned-breed list for dogs.
lines: Oman Customs says a prior veterinary permit must be obtained through the Bayan system before the pet arrives, at a fee of OMR 20. It is normally approved within two hours on any day of the week.

The permit file needs the immunisation record since birth, a photo of the pet, the microchip number, and a rabies antibody blood test from an accredited laboratory. The pet must be over four months old, vaccinated against rabies after 12 weeks of age and within the last 12 months, with blood drawn 21 to 30 days after the last vaccine and the result dated 3 to 12 months before export.

Under Resolution 222/2019 dogs of listed breeds are barred, among them Pit Bull, Staffordshire Terrier, American Bully, Rottweiler, Doberman, Boxer, Great Dane and Japanese Tosa, and mixes of them. On arrival you present the permit, the exporting country's government health certificate, the passport or vaccination record and the lab certificate.
